scope: exact histogram-conditioned enumerative coding of categorical snapshots with up to 4096 symbols

checks.wire_compatibility: preserve all four existing baseline layouts and the registered default diagnostics and baseline CSV
checks.exactness: verify model bits, ranks, rank width and exact bytes with independent permutation enumeration and integer factorial references
checks.round_trip: empty, singleton, skewed, balanced and relabeled samples including ranks wider than 64 bits round-trip exactly
checks.rejection: reject invalid labels, frequency totals, ranks, truncation and nonzero padding; report the IID region limit without losing later supported observations
checks.install: exercise the CLI and installed decoder through all three conformance hosts

limits: conditional two-part IID reference with an externally supplied code ID. No cross-family selection, held-out fitting or scientific conclusion.
